records.title: RobustKV: Defending Large Language Models against Jailbreak Attacks via KV Eviction
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との接続または一般化可能なLLM推論効率効果が弱く、具体的な追加検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 RobustKV evicts low-ranked KV entries to suppress jailbreak tokens and evaluates attack resistance and benign-task quality. The paper uses cache eviction, but its objective is safety; it does not establish cache-capacity, latency or throughput gains for serving.

records.title: Critic-CoT: Boosting the reasoning abilities of large language model via Chain-of-thoughts Critic
records.reason: 一次資料abstractおよび本文を確認。Critic-CoT trains a stepwise self-critic with automatically constructed supervision to improve reasoning accuracy. The work is a reasoning-training method and reports no inference serving efficiency or optimizer-state/offload mechanism.

records.title: Adaptive Rank Selections for Low-Rank Approximation of Language Models
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との接続または一般化可能なLLM推論効率効果が弱く、具体的な追加検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 Adaptive SVD rank masks allocate rank per operation and improve compressed-model accuracy, including LLaMA, with little or no fine-tuning. The available publisher text supports compression relevance, but no concrete inference latency/throughput result was established in the reviewed evidence.

records.title: Mentor-KD: Making Small Language Models Better Multi-step Reasoners
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との接続または一般化可能なLLM推論効率効果が弱く、具体的な追加検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 Mentor-KD transfers multi-step reasoning from a teacher to smaller language models and evaluates reasoning accuracy.
